notes: Pilot: 10 BH + 10 RS seeds at 100000 steps (campaign pilot-bcl1). The NEP89 GM is the Mackay icosahedron, in agreement with the Cambridge Cluster Database (many-body potentials) and DFT/photoelectron spectra of Ag55- (Haekkinen et al., PRL 93, 093401 (2004)); the Ino decahedron and cuboctahedron are about 2 eV higher. RS never got within 0.68 eV (median gap 1.36 eV). The 10 BH hits are identical (spread 0.2 meV), so e_tol = 0.02. Final budget 43000 = 3 x median BH hit step (14330); all BH pilot hits were at <= 41408 steps.
